summary: Minimal one-line fix guards imaginary-coordinate validation behind the `evaluate` flag, consistent with how evaluate=False defers other checks/simplifications elsewhere in sympy, and directly resolves the reported crash.

issues.description: With evaluate=False, a Point can now be constructed with genuinely imaginary coordinates without raising; acceptable since evaluate=False intentionally defers validation/evaluation, but worth noting as a behavior change from strict pre-patch validation.
